home.title: Tora Player
home.subtitle: Daily Torah Lessons
home.welcomeDesc: Listen to daily Torah lessons anytime, anywhere

homeIntro.title: Everything you can do here
homeIntro.lead: Tora Player is built to be easy to learn from anywhere. To open a lesson and see all of it, tap the lesson's title. Here is what you have:

items.offline: Listen without internet: save a lesson to your device and it stays available on the go.
items.download: Download to your device: keep the audio file on your device, or share it.
items.resume: Pick up where you stopped: the player remembers where you left off, and once you sign in to the site, across your devices too.
items.bookmarks: Bookmarks and notes: mark an important moment in a lesson and add a note of your own.
items.controls: Control your listening: playback speed, a sleep timer and driving mode with large buttons.
items.notifications: New-lesson alerts: allow notifications when the browser asks, and get a message as soon as a new lesson goes up. Signing up on the site is easiest, and the update also comes by email.
items.search: Search by topic and date: tap a #tag or a date to see similar lessons.
items.share: Share a lesson: tap the share button share icon to send a link to the lesson on WhatsApp, by email or in any other app. The button is in the player: on the lesson page below the play buttons, in the mini player at the bottom of the screen and in the full player.

homeIntro.lessonPage: Lesson page: tapping the lesson's title, or anywhere on its card, opens the lesson page with all its details: the recording's parts and the length of each part, the pictures, tags, bookmarks and notes.
